source.origin: project-authored boot stub source, contract 2 (plan 07-05, D-09, D-10)

note: project boot stub contract 2, not an EXEC; never used as proof of EXEC compatibility; built images live only in the build tree. Order of the evidence: the contract is derived in docs/diagnostics.md (the boot stub contract 2 section), boot-stub-2.asm is the source of truth, and boot-stub-2.listing.txt is generated from it by ivs_asm (the project mini-assembler, plan 07-03 and 07-04) and committed unedited; a suite test regenerates it and requires byte equality. The reset path is word for word that of contract 1 (fixtures/FX-boot-stub); the interrupt entry is the single instruction JD to the cartridge interrupt entry 5004. Nothing is copied from another implementation or assembler and no third-party byte is present. tools/pack builds the 8192-byte EXEC image from the listing into build/<preset>/images/boot-stub-2.exec; no image is committed. recipe.sources and tool_sha256 are verified by the manifests step: any edit of the source, of tools/asm/asm.c or of tools/pack/pack.c refreshes the recipe digests, and any edit of the listing or the source refreshes the outputs entries (cmake -E sha256sum and size), in the same commit.
